reviews.review: If your searching for a co-op shooter, look no further, this gem will give many hours of enjoyment!

I might just be what you call "over qualified" when it comes to writing reviews of media containing, what the majority of the population would call "dwarfs". Because, considering my long and, quite frankly arduous journey through the deepest corridors of "short people media incorporated" [i](based in Village City, Connecticut)[/i], I've not only been exposed to the issues that short people face everyday [i](known as "shortism")[/i], but also, and maybe even more importantly given the subject matter; the issues that the rest of us are exposed to by having them in the work force.

And let me be abundantly clear; we are not talking about people who are born short. These people are often very nice, and you should look up to them [i](metaphorically of course, as it would probably be incredibly hard to do so in a more physical fashion, unless you were laying down, and to be completely honest; I wouldn't blame you)[/i].
No; the people that I, obviously have an issue with are people who are short by choice. These people are not to be trusted, especially in an office environment due to their preference in coffee cup - which always, by some weird reason also seems to align with YOUR preference.
You don't have to have a PhD in [b]MAGIC STUDIES AND RESEARCH OF MAGIC STUDIES AND RESEARCH[/b] [i](like me)[/i], to see where that whole scenario ends up...

Now, you might be asking yourself; "why would these people choose to be short?"
And, oh boy - let me tell you. They are in it for the complementary farms.
You see in the Western Plains, there are, due to the overarching narrative that the dictator is pushing, and absolute abundance of abandoned farms. And instead of going the route of the Eastern Plains and burning these in order to procure a limited source of warmth and fire, the westerners started giving out these farms to people who were under 40 centimetres in height.

And as you might imagine; not a lot of people were over 40 centimetres in height, especially not at the time. So they lowered the requirement to just under 36 centimetres.
This resulted in a few things;
1. The complete and utter destruction of the nuclear power plant in Fort Lauderdale [i](a lot of people are still saying this was a coincidence, but like, come on... pffft)[/i]
2. The summoning of [b]Jake, the wizard[/b].
And with Jake came the small spells. And thusly, the corruption of the small, small people culture.

Jake took payments for making long, tall, round, and regular small people into small, small people. These payments would wary, from firstborns, first loves, first houses or even, in rare occurrences first USB powered refrigerators. Uncool.

The legend was, however was, that a group of four regular dwarfs went out into the great, "most dangerous caves" which were the most dangerous caves in the universe in order to gather minerals and rocks.
Because Jake hated these. And he was bad.

Be prepared to engrave the words "ROCK AND STONE" like muslims have for salam alaikum

No, but seriously, this game is super fun especially with friends. the more the merrier

Unlike most games nowadays, this game is all about having fun. No tedious grinds for RNG, no DLCs (as of the time of this review), no pay2win. Just 100% fun.

Also, the devs actually care about making a good game, which is insanely rare these days. They just released the official 1.0 of the game and actually left early access (that should tell you a lot!).
